definitions.explanation: Having or showing great skill and expertise, especially in using hands or words.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{話術|わじゅつ}が{巧|たく}みだ。
{巧|たく}みな{言|い}い{回|まわ}しで{相手|あいて}を{説得|せっとく}した。
examples.english: He persuaded the other party with clever phrasing.

examples.japanese: {職人|しょくにん}が{巧|たく}みの{技|わざ}を{披露|ひろう}した。
examples.english: The craftsman demonstrated his skillful techniques.
examples.notes: {巧|たく}み as a noun meaning 'skill/technique'

notes:
FORMS:
・{巧|たく}みな + noun - skillful (modifier)
・{巧|たく}みに + verb - skillfully (adverb)
・{巧|たく}みの{技|わざ} - skillful technique (noun)

ORTHOGRAPHY:
Often written in hiragana as たくみ. The kanji {巧|たく}み emphasizes skill; {匠|たくみ} refers to a craftsman/artisan.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{巧|たく}みな{話術|わじゅつ} - skillful speaking
・{巧|たく}みに{操|あやつ}る - to skillfully manipulate
・{巧|たく}みな{嘘|うそ} - clever lie
・{言葉巧|ことばたく}みに - with clever words

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{上手|じょうず} - good at, skilled (more common)
・{器用|きよう} - dexterous, handy
・{熟練|じゅくれん} - proficient, experienced
